test_title: PYST 09: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 09 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
The given sentence is divided into four segments. Select the option that has the segment with a grammatical error.

She forbade / him not / to enter that / room.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the word "**not**" with the verb "**forbade**."
 
• The verb **"forbade"** already implies a negative action, so the word "not" is redundant and incorrect.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**forbade him to enter**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

**Correct Sentence:** *"She forbade him to enter that room."*
